# 2relay artwork checkpoint

Two sealed-package top labels and rear specification label are exact vector artwork converted to PNG with original glyph contours and terminal symbols. Targeted projection follows the existing solid relay-package tops and original rear recess. The separate small front Grove marking visible in product photos is outside these three supplied flat originals and remains an outstanding detail.

Only the final PNG rasters and surface-registration code are distributed. Raw vectors, private source URLs, table/mappings and conversion intermediates remain outside every Git repository. The images retain M5Stack artwork rights; final raster redistribution follows the user's authorization.

All print panels are children of explicit pre-existing physical shell/package surfaces. `new Model({artwork:false})` and `new GroveModule({artwork:false})` suppress them. No film bridge or replacement structure was added. Existing sensor, terminal, LED and Grove APIs are preserved.

`stickers-smoke.json` records finite projected geometry/UV, correct parent targets, unprinted mounting bores, both public classes' artwork option, four-wire Grove pose/detach/disposal and relevant independent LED/screw smoke. Exact physical mesh buffers/world transforms/materials and component APIs match the pre-edit snapshot across 8 configurations. This is a local artwork checkpoint, without browser, full regression, production-fit or physical-device acceptance.
